name: Crystal Conservatory — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Glass-and-gold conservatory with a tall ribbed dome/arched frame, marble base, front moon pool and abundant orchids/hanging planting. Delicate frame and botanical interior are dominant; no opaque palace block is shown. Hidden layout inference: A small entrance apron leads to a planted perimeter walk around the moon pool, with two sheltered seating/view pockets and an upper canopy view where source supports it. Keep plant beds lush while preserving a clear loop and glazing vistas. Hidden rear bench/garden is proposed. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B25-DETAIL-001 — Crystal Conservatory — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need glass wall/roof rib corner/entry assemblies, pond-floor/bed edging and hanging planter supports. Audit PAL-CONSERV-SURF subtype and reported differing floor/footrail before reuse; do not assume every conservatory shares it. Orchid/vine/fern forms and butterflies need local selection; no whole greenhouse model proven. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
